name: Aholibamah
overview: Aholibamah is identified in Scripture as a wife of Esau and the daughter of Anah, herself descended from Zibeon, highlighting her place within Edomite lineage. She bore Esau three sons—Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah—linking her directly to the continuation of Esau's family line. The texts suggest she may be the same person as Judith, also mentioned as a wife of Esau, underscoring the complex naming and familial connections within the Edomite princes. Additionally, Aholibamah is noted as a duke, indicating her prominence and status among Edom's leadership.
